source: the live CSSOM on apollographql.com (the compiled _next/static/css bundles are same-origin, readable); semantic names resolved on a .dark probe, one theme per page, at 1440 x 900

context: @supports ((-webkit-hyphens:none) and (not (margin-trim:inline))) or ((-moz-orient:inline) and (not (color:rgb(from red r g b))))

properties.--font-sans: ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif,"Apple Color Emoji","Segoe UI Emoji","Segoe UI Symbol","Noto Color Emoji"

tailwind.selector: .prose-headings\:font-normal :where(h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, th):not(:where([class~="not-prose"], [class~="not-prose"] *))
.prose-headings\:tracking-normal :where(h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, th):not(:where([class~="not-prose"], [class~="not-prose"] *))

--default-font-family.raw: ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif,"Apple Color Emoji","Segoe UI Emoji","Segoe UI Symbol","Noto Color Emoji"
--default-font-family.value: ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif,"Apple Color Emoji","Segoe UI Emoji","Segoe UI Symbol","Noto Color Emoji"

--font-sans.raw: ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif,"Apple Color Emoji","Segoe UI Emoji","Segoe UI Symbol","Noto Color Emoji"
--font-sans.value: ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif,"Apple Color Emoji","Segoe UI Emoji","Segoe UI Symbol","Noto Color Emoji"
